column1: # The rookie ship's civilian fit (R-ECON §2.4, packet E7; starter_ship::TABLE;
# race's corvette (the bundle's agents/races.tsv `ship_type_id` [V]) and fits
# these modules into it, one row per module, in row order, each into the
# lowest free slot of its own rack. A row whose module does not fit the hull
# is skipped and logged. Restart to apply.
# The client ships no starter fit: no FSD resource, no python table (searched
# for build 3619879: only the civilian type constants exist, in
# inventorycommon/const and shipfitting/fittingWarningConst) [V]. So every row
# is ours, [A]: a civilian gun of the race's turret family, the civilian
# miner and the civilian afterburner, a plausible
# rookie fit. Falsified by a Tranquility capture of a fresh
# ship_type_id: the corvette. type_id: one module. why: the falsifier.
